== Strategy ==

Basic Strategy:  Get out the Jedi Chamber as fast as you can.  If you test the deck out and see that you cant get it out in 1-3 turns add another Speak with the coucnil.  Set up Threepio at Jedi Chamber and track/get cards you need.(no priority but helps).  Set up Qui-Gon always on Naboo with drains and his saber thanks to the new Virtual card.  Use either Yoda or Mace to occupy the other site and max our your drains.  Do this FAST where if you can hit them for 4 a turn for the rest of the game starting turn 1 or 2 is a win.  Make EPP strikes using Jedi Resilence and Spies to block up the drains away from Dark Jedi..  Preety Simple eh....
